n, bitCoins = map(int, input().split())
values = input().split()

odd = 0
even = 0
count = 0
val = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    if int(values[i]) % 2 == 0:
        even += 1
    else:
        odd += 1
    if odd == even:
        diff = abs(int(values[i + 1]) - int(values[i]))
        val.append(diff)

val.sort()

for v in val:
    if v <= bitCoins:
        bitCoins -= v
        count += 1
    else:
        break

print(count)
</translated_code>
